title: Celestin as a musician; two trumpets and harmony
summary: She calls Celestin likable and capable. His band used two trumpets for harmony, and trombones harmonized in the big band.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: What kind of a band did it with Celestine? I mean, was he a very good musician?
I think he was all right. A very likable person. He, he, what he did play, played well.
Why did he use two trumpets, you know, most of the time? Just...
Well, I imagine for harmony. They always had two trumpets.
I mean, even when you joined the band.
For harmony, you see, you always, in order to have everything sound right, you would have to have harmony. And one trumpet couldn't do it alone. You'd have to have first and second.
I know. Were there right parts where the trombone would harmonize with the trumpet?
Oh, yes. With a big band, they did that.
Yeah. Yeah. And the trombone would have started in the songs.
I think so. I can't recall too well about those things.
Well, we could listen to the records and see what it was.
Uh-huh. But I'm sure they had to have a harmony in order for it to sound right.
